definitions.explanation: The public funeral ceremony where mourners come to pay their final respects to the deceased and their family. Distinct from the private family wake ({通夜|つや}).

examples.japanese: {告別式|こくべつしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The funeral service will be held tomorrow afternoon.

examples.japanese: {告別式|こくべつしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}した→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧。
{告別式|こくべつしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弔辞|ちょうじ}→弔辞：22501_chouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I delivered a eulogy at the funeral service.

notes:
{告別式|こくべつしき} is the main public funeral ceremony in Japanese funeral customs.

TYPICAL SEQUENCE:
1. ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧: Wake (evening before, family and close friends)
2. {告別式|こくべつしき}: Funeral service (main ceremony)
3. ⟦{火葬|かそう}→火葬：noentry⟧: Cremation
4. ⟦{骨上|こつあ}げ→骨上げ：noentry⟧: Bone-picking ceremony

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {告別式|こくべつしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}する→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧: to attend a funeral
- {告別式|こくべつしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧: to hold a funeral service
- ⟦{弔辞|ちょうじ}→弔辞：22501_chouji⟧: eulogy
